impaakt.description:
Team collaboration on development processes and technologies used.

Development and maintenance of the SaaS Sustainability Report: web application for double materiality assessment processes to provide graphs and sustainability reports based on data collected from companies, their clients, and stakeholders.

  • Back-end SSR Nuxt 3 for App/RESTful API.

Prototyping of a calculator How Sustainable to Me: application to guide your sustainability investments based on your own convictions.

  • Front-end MVVM Vue 2 for navigation.
  • UI/UX Front-end Kit Vuetify 2 for UI/UX.
  • Back-end SSR Nuxt 2 for content management.
  • Back-end MVC2 Laravel for RESTful API.
  • SQL-database MySQL for remote DB.
  • Graphical rendering D3.js for data processing.
  • Puppeteer Node.js for PDF generation.

Post-studies and projects

>Musical CreAItion with Suno

Writing lyrics and poems and setting them to music using the composition and interpretation tools of the Generative AI Suno.

  • Argumenta Pro Melodiam
    Creation of an AI-bum where music thinks, doubts, and blends critical thinking, humanity, and sonic poetry.
  • Insert song: Sung adaptations
    Translation-adaptation of various music from games, films, ads and series.
Use of Generative AI

Using generative AI for self-training, content creation, and project quality improvement including AIs available in Mammouth AI.

  • Creation of YouTube thumbnails, MP3 cover art.
  • Code improvement with Cursor, Copilot, and Claude.
  • Improving interactions with AIs.
  • Continuous watch on generative AIs, their use, and impact.
Critical Thinking

Study of critical thinking and the scientific method with the tool Zététique (Skepticism) and daily practice via the Zetetique.wiki project.

  • Daily automated skeptical news,
  • Introductory videos,
  • Video courses from professionals,
  • Creation of summary sheets
Coop Collaboration

Discovery and trial of collaboration in a Coop (worker cooperative) with the company Amétis offering a plurality of services in various fields.

Business Creation

Co-creation of the company Orchard ID and implementation of a philosophy of sharing and equality with company steering based on the desire and well-being of its employees rather than on objectives set by management.

Blogging

Publishing posts on personal blog or on other platforms like Developpez.com. Translations of posts on Medium. Technology watch via social networks.

Nuxt

Participation in the official French translation of Nuxt 2. Translations of various documentation pages.

Vue

Creation and management of the official French translation team for Vue 2 on Github. Translations of various documentation pages.

Vanilla JS

Complete documentation and Benchmark of Vanilla JS compared to jQuery for developing in native JavaScript.

Node.js

Creation of NodeAtlas, an engine for MVC2 architecture for HTML assets, websites or real-time web applications. Stack: ExpressJS, EJS, Socket.io, commander, mongoose, etc. Sharing on GitHub.

Mobile First Architecture

Creation of Front-end responsive structures oriented Mobile first, multi-browser with fallback for old browsers (Modernizr) and Websocket/AJAX exchange.

Performance and SEO

Image optimization (sprite/base64), CSS minification, JS obfuscation, compliance with W3C standards, parallel loading under Apache environment.

PHP

Development of an MVC2 architecture, with personal PHP 5.4 Framework, oriented Front-End (HTML5/CSS3/JS): multi-platform, browser interoperability, multilingual, multi-template, print, real-time editing...

Avatar Community

Avatar Community is a community platform halfway between a website and a forum. It allows exchange around James Cameron's Avatar universe.

Compilation of FFVII

Compilation of Final Fantasy VII is a community site around the Final Fantasy VII universe. This site gathers a large number of texts and information on the Compilation of Final Fantasy VII, directly from Japan and in French.

about.title: About me
about.description:
I am a web developer specializing in JavaScript between Annecy and Geneva, living my passion every day, swimming among current and future techniques regarding Vanilla JS or Vue.js front-end user interfaces, Node.js development, and web and AI technologies. That's why every day at breakfast (but not only), I prepare something to satisfy my hunger for Responsive Web Design, web performance, respect for standards, best practices, POC HTML5 / CSS3 / ES6+, web accessibility, factorization, automation, sharing, puzzles of all kinds, generative AIs, and this through increasingly appetizing projects and prototypes.

Latest big dish? Daily work to use the best tools at my disposal for acquiring the most parsimonious knowledge possible as well as self-work to produce the most charitable judgments regarding objectifiable reality. You can find the compilation of this work on my site https://www.zetetique.wiki/.

You can find me on LinkedIn during my watch hours to talk about: design, development, integration, ergonomics, optimization, performance, SEO, web, AI, tech, sustainable development, or even critical thinking and video games!

... more details on my site.

... more details on https://www.lesieur.name/a-propos/.

What entertains me

  • Understanding why LOST ended like that,
  • Cultivating problems based on solutions,
  • Singing over TV theme songs,
  • Doing R&D lost in my browser tabs,
  • Rolling around in Heelys,
  • Typing non-breaking spaces using the Bépo layout,
  • Summoning my critical thinking (is anybody home?)
  • Running marathons on Codesignal,
  • Being eco-friendly when it suits me,
  • Escaping unfortunate incidents with a loaded die,
  • And lots of other Unknowns... and Vice & versa.
